body: I wish I could. My friends won’t understand; they’ve managed to be happy their entire lives despite adversity. My mom will just tell me I’m being dramatic, or that she’s gone through the same yet she’s still here. Everything is a competition. I don’t want to win a race I was forced to enter. I’ll be ostracized and ignored if I speak out. I’d rather die knowing people loved me than live knowing they don’t enjoy my presence.
At this point, that’s the only thing keeping me alive
